fields.Name: T254 - Tags Library Search and Drilldown
fields.Description: Exercises the custom tag-library table search (FilterTags) plus per-tag drill-down (DrillDownTag) — a bespoke table, not the generic entity grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo), open 'Tags' and go to the 'Tag Library' (tags) section. Type a term into the 'Search tags...' box in the section toolbar and confirm the tag table narrows to matching rows (or shows a clear empty result). Then clear the search and click a tag row. Success is that clicking a tag opens a drill-down panel listing content items tagged with that tag (or a 'No content items found for this tag' empty state). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the tag search box narrows the tag table to matching rows OR shows a valid no-match state
Clicking a tag row opens a drill-down listing its content items OR a clear empty state for that tag
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
